record.title: What do I do with “Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups”?

context.notes:
From the note “Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups”:

Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups
Captured November 9, 2026, the day after the Circle City Build hackathon. Our team built Seedling, a demo that turns a photo of a garden bed into a planting plan. We placed second.
Contacts
Dana Ruiz · Crossroads Capital (seed fund, Indianapolis). Judge. Said the demo was the most polished of the weekend. Asked what I am working on next.
Leo Park · Mentor. Spent an hour with us Saturday on scoping. Gave advice about cutting the onboarding flow; details are fuzzy.
Priya Nair · Attendee. Product designer at a health-tech startup. Wanted to see the demo again.
Sam Ortiz · Teammate. Junior developer, between jobs, did most of the image pipeline.
Possible intros for Sam: Mei Chen (engineering manager, Stripe), Tom Hale (design lead, Figma). I told Sam I would introduce him.
Events
Fountain Square Dev Breakfast, November 20, 2026, 8–10 a.m., Hotel Tango. Not RSVPed.
Me
I am looking for my next role (staff engineer or founding engineer). Seedling is a side project; I do not plan to turn it into a company.

nodes.title: What do I do with “Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups”?

tasks.title: Email Dana asking for 2-3 portfolio intros
tasks.result: Sent Nov 10. Dana replied the same day: she will intro me to Harbor Health (Series A, hiring a founding engineer) and asked for a short bio first.

tasks.title: Ask Sam what he wants from the intros
tasks.result: Sam wants backend roles, not design work. Tom at Figma is not a fit. Mei at Stripe is.
